::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
The following information is intended as a brief introduction and reminder of how to use shared checklists in eBird. For complete instructions, see the eBird Help Center article [Editing and Sharing Checklists](https://support.ebird.org/en/support/solutions/articles/48000625567-editing-and-sharing-checklists).
:::

## Editing eBird Checklists

Checklists that have already been submitted can be edited either in the eBird Mobile app or on the eBird website.

### Editing checklists on the eBird Mobile app

1.  Open the eBird Mobile app
2.  Tap "Checklists" at the bottom of the home screen
3.  Select the "Submitted" tab
4.  Select the checklist you want to edit
5.  Tap the pencil icon in the upper right corner
6.  Tap the check mark and species total at the bottom of the screen to switch between the full species list and only the species recorded on the checklist.
7.  Edit the species list or counts.
    a.  Add species by tapping the plus button at the top of the screen.
    b.  Remove species by swiping right on the species name.
    c.  Change numbers by tapping the number to increment it, or tap the species name to open the details page and edit the count there.
8.  Tap "Review" and then "Submit" to save your changes

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
Changes made in the app will also appear on the eBird website.

For instructions on editing an eBird checklist on the website, see [eBird Help Center: Editing eBird Checklists](https://support.ebird.org/en/support/solutions/articles/48000625567-editing-and-sharing-checklists#anchorEditChecklists).
:::

## Sharing Checklists

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
eBird allows multiple observers to share copies of the same checklist. This is helpful so not every person has to keep an eBird checklist going in the field. One person can do it and share with the others afterwards.
:::

### Sharing while entering a checklist on eBird Mobile 

1.  Start a checklist in eBird Mobile.
2.  Increase the "Number of Observers" to more than 1.
3.  Tap the "Share checklist with..." option that appears.
4.  Enter the eBird username of a person you are birding with and press the Enter key.
5.  Repeat for each additional person you want to share the checklist with.
6.  Submit the checklist normally.

After the checklist is submitted, eBird will automatically send an email to each person with the option to accept or reject the shared checklist.

-   Note: Once a checklist has already been submitted through eBird Mobile, increasing the "Number of Observers" will no longer make the "Share checklist with..." option appear. To share an already submitted checklist, open the checklist in the app, tap the curved arrow icon in the upper right corner (the middle icon), and follow the "Sharing checklists on the eBird website" instructions below.

### Sharing checklists on the eBird website

1.  Go to "Manage My Checklists" in My eBird.
2.  Select the checklist you want to share.
3.  Click the "Share" icon to the right of your name on the checklist page, OR click the blue "Checklist Tools" button and select "Share w/ others in your party".
4.  In the "To" field, enter the eBird usernames of the people you want to share the checklist with.
5.  Alternatively, select names from your eBird Contacts list to fill in their usernames automatically.
6.  Click the "Share Checklist" button.

### Sharing from a Trip Report

Clicking a checklist in the course Trip Report on the website will open the original submitter's copy of the checklist. You cannot share that copy with additional people; you can only share your own copy of the checklist.

To open your copy of the checklist:

1.  Click the people icon next to the submitter's name in the left column to display the full list of people the checklist has been shared with.
2.  Click the page icon next to your name. This will open your copy of the checklist.

Share the checklist using the instructions under "Sharing checklists on the eBird website" above.

## Accepting Shared Checklists

There are three ways to accept shared checklists:

-   You will receive an email for each checklist shared with you. Click the link in the email to accept the checklist.

-   Click "Manage My Checklists" on My eBird and look for shared checklists at the top of the page. Click "Accept".

-   Add someone as a Friend in your eBird Contacts and any checklist shared with you by that person will automatically be accepted into your account.

    ::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
    You can add students as Contacts and make them Friends on the [Manage My Contacts](https://ebird.org/manage/contacts) page. Add the student as a contact (or find them in your existing contacts list) and check the "Friends" checkbox next to their name. See the eBird Help Center article [eBird Contacts and Friends](https://support.ebird.org/en/support/solutions/articles/48001049405) for more detailed instructions.
    :::

## Editing a Shared Checklist

Once you have accepted a shared checklist, you can edit it like any other checklist.

On eBird Mobile, go to the "Checklists" button and the "Submitted" tab. You should see the shared checklist there. If not, pull down to refresh the list. Select the checklist and edit it following the instructions above.

Note: Editing the species list and counts on a shared checklist only affects your personal copy of the checklist, not the copies belonging to other observers.
